- It then verified the bundle in a fresh clone of canon, fetched st0011-16 there at 90ee95b3 with the tip's tree, and removed the clone.

THE ROWS: AT-5.1 to AT-5.3 cover AC-5.1 to AC-5.3, and AT-5.4 covers AC-5.5; AC-5.4 takes none. Each cites tests/unit/cache.bats, and each note describes its arms (8, 3, 2 and 3; their '# AT-5.x' lines are at the tip).
They stand at to-write because intent at red refused the first verdict: "AT-5.1 cites `tests/unit/cache.bats`, which does not exist, so `red` would make it a live absent_at finding ... refused rather than warned because the finding it would create refuses EVERY commit in this repository". cache.bats lands with the unit. AT-3.10 to AT-3.15's precedent (20624440) could take verdicts before its landing because ci-state.bats was already on main.
THE VERDICTS ARE READY, the run's evidence checked arm by arm: each of the 16 arms is red at the red clone 2ce10c70 and ok exactly once, never skipped, in the GNU arms TAP, the GNU light TAP and the BSD whole log. The moment you send main's new head, I set each row red with the red clone's evidence and then green with the run's, as AT-3.10 to AT-3.14 were (scratchpad at-mint.sh verdicts). Then I re-run intent at lint ST0011 and send you the output and the commit's sha. I expect 20 findings, since WP16's id lines in releaselegs.bats (5 x AT-3.1) and macos.bats (11 x AT-3.4) clear two of main's, with no finding on the four rows. If you would rather set the verdicts yourself, the notes are in that script.
